measured_scope: Warm resident single CPU process: public input copy, actual query encoding when required, prediction, registered skill execution, output canonicalization. Golden scoring is excluded from per-request latency.
memory_measurement: Weights/index/source/profile/optimizer file and array sizes are reported. Process RAM, allocator overhead, page-cache residency, and peak activation memory were not isolated per method.
method_order: seeded independent permutations per request; request order permuted each repetition

network_measurement.reason: Cross-node transport is a separate measurement; local timing cannot establish a network benefit.

profile_exact.scope: Three constructed projects across four version frontiers; linked repeated snapshots, not twelve independent tasks. Source resolution runs inside timed prediction; no encoder and only the original public project-name request.

quality_constraint: Timing differences alone do not establish a cost victory when accepted coverage or task quality differs. Compare equal-quality operating points before amortized economic claims.

train_feature_encoding.attribution: One common train-feature encoding, reported separately; methods use the identical frozen training matrix.

dedicated_runtime.attribution: whole dedicated pinned dependency directory including dependencies; not peak RSS

excluded_or_separate: model migration network bytes and latency

shared_encoder.amortization: one resident shared encoder; never duplicate-counted as independent per-cell models

sources.note: Authored dataset artifacts contain evaluator goldens too; these are provenance files, not an asserted minimal production store.

storage.units: bytes; physical files and logical arrays are separate, non-additive views

training_evidence.interpretation: Previously incurred adapter/candidate training wall time and presentations; per-method CPU training and source-ingestion totals are not inferred. Common train-feature encoding is separately measured in setup.
